pro-eq.name: Blak Marigold Pro EQ
notes: Low Cut and High Cut slopes now include 36 and 48 dB/oct; saved songs keep their slope
Smaller Check for Updates button that sits inside the toolbar
Gain knobs are always +/-24 dB and the GAIN 24 dB button is gone; saved gains are unchanged
The EQ curve and controls stay fully lit when no audio is playing
Installer welcome and finish headings wrap and fit at any display scaling

pro-comp.name: Blak Marigold Pro Comp
pro-comp.notes: Adds Check for updates and a cleaner installer welcome page.
